summary: Iteration 115: Production push verification - Refactored modules, subscription UI, sorting. Fixed critical bug in vehicles_admin.py auth. All 18 backend tests pass, frontend verified.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: vehicles_admin.py had incorrect function signatures - get_current_user and get_admin_user were passing Request instead of HTTPAuthorizationCredentials. Fixed by updating signatures to match parent functions in vehicles.py
Refactoring verified: auctions.py reduced from 1139 to 372 lines, vehicles.py reduced from 2543 to 1165 lines
New modules created: auctions_bids.py (687 lines), vehicles_admin.py (1510 lines)
Translation service has graceful degradation - when GEMINI_API_KEY missing, logs warning and skips translation (listing saves normally)
Subscription pricing page correctly filters to show only 3 plans (free, premium, vip) - partner_pro excluded via frontend filter
3-column grid layout confirmed on pricing page (md:grid-cols-3)
Marketplace default sort is 'ending_soon' - countdown timers visible on all cards
Ending Soon badge (data-testid='ending-soon-badge') CSS exists with Flame icon - only appears for items <1h remaining
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 115 verified all refactored modules working. Fixed auth bug in vehicles_admin.py. Subscription page at /pricing (not /subscriptions). Backend API returns 4 plans but frontend filters to 3. Ending Soon badge only appears when <1h remaining - currently no items in that window.

tests_performed.test: API /api/marketplace/items returns items sorted by ending_soon
Subscription plans API returns expected plans
Pricing page shows 3 plan cards (no partner_pro)
Countdown timers visible on marketplace cards

bug_fixed.issue: get_current_user and get_admin_user functions had incorrect signatures - were passing Request object instead of HTTPAuthorizationCredentials
bug_fixed.root_cause: During refactoring, the wrapper functions in vehicles_admin.py were created with Request parameter but the parent functions in vehicles.py expect HTTPAuthorizationCredentials from Depends(security)
bug_fixed.fix: Updated function signatures to use HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security) to match parent functions
bug_fixed.impact: All vehicle admin endpoints were returning 500 Internal Server Error
